title: 401k Contribution Limit 2024 - Max Savings Guide
excerpt: Learn the 401k contribution limits for 2024 and how to maximize your retirement savings. Includes Roth 401k comparison.
content:
Planning for retirement? Understanding 401k contribution limits helps you maximize your savings tax-free.

## 2024 401k Contribution Limits

For 2024, you can contribute:
- Under 50: $23,000
- 50 and older: $30,500 (catch-up contribution)

## Traditional vs Roth 401k

**Traditional 401k:**
- Contributions reduce taxable income now
- Taxes paid upon withdrawal

**Roth 401k:**
- Contributions are after-tax
- Withdrawals are tax-free

## Employer Match

Don't leave free money on the table! Most employers match contributions up to a certain percentage. Aim to contribute at least enough to get the full match.

## How to Calculate

Use our compound interest calculator to see how your 401k grows over time with different contribution amounts.
